items.question: Who can attend the retreat?
items.answer: The retreat welcomes men aged 29–60 who are navigating divorce, a breakup, burnout, or another significant life change.

items.question: When is the retreat, and how long is the stay?
items.answer: The retreat dates are to be confirmed. Your package includes seven days of accommodation. Confirmed dates and arrival and departure details will be shared before bookings open.

items.question: What is included in the package?
items.answer: Your package includes seven days of accommodation, all meals, coaching, scheduled retreat activities, airport pickup, and transportation during the retreat. Optional follow-up coaching after the retreat is available separately.

items.question: Which airport should I fly into?
items.answer: We recommend Hilo International Airport (ITO), the closest airport to the retreat. Airport pickup is included. Shuttle transfers from Kona International Airport (KOA) are also included.

items.question: What are the room and bathroom arrangements?
items.answer: You can choose a private room or a bed in shared accommodation. Private rooms use shared bathrooms. Shared accommodation is available in two dorms, each with an ensuite bathroom shared by guests staying in that dorm.

items.question: Do I need to be fit, and are activities mandatory?
items.answer: All fitness levels are welcome. Activities are optional, so you can choose what you participate in and sit out whenever you need.

items.question: What food is provided, and what if I have allergies?
items.answer: Meals are served buffet-style, with a focus on balanced, healthy food. Please tell us about any food allergies before booking so we can discuss whether we can accommodate your needs.

items.question: What can I expect from the coaching sessions?
items.answer: You will take part in role-play exercises with constructive, supportive feedback, alongside one-to-one sessions with the coaches. The aim is to learn together, reconnect with yourself, and build a brotherhood of support in a safe, respectful environment. Participation is optional.

items.question: Is the retreat a form of therapy?
items.answer: The retreat is a personal-development experience built around coaching, reflection, movement, and peer connection. It is not a substitute for individual therapy or medical care.

items.question: Can I receive support after the retreat?
items.answer: Yes. An optional follow-up package offers continued support through live calls with your chosen coach. Details and pricing will be shared during the retreat. This package is separate from the retreat price.

items.question: Will my personal conversations stay private?
items.answer: Guests and coaches will agree to keep personal conversations and other participants’ stories confidential. Respect for one another’s privacy is part of the retreat experience.

items.question: Will I be photographed or filmed?
items.answer: We will ask for your written consent before photographing or filming you. You can choose not to give consent.

items.question: Can I book or pay for a place now?
items.answer: Bookings and payments are not open yet. You can explore the room options and pricing preview, and contact us at info@primalresetretreats.com with questions. Confirmed dates and final booking terms will be shared before payments are accepted.
